description_en: Initiates a security scan task against a scan target that has passed connectivity verification. After the task is created, it is asynchronously prepared and executed
description_zh: 对已通过连通性验证的扫描目标发起安全扫描任务，创建成功后任务异步准备与执行
name: CreateTargetScanTask

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the scan target. The target must have passed connectivity verification (verifyStatus=verified). Otherwise, a 400 error is returned. You can call TestConnectivity to complete the verification first
parameters.help_zh: 扫描目标的唯一标识。目标必须已通过连通性验证（verifyStatus=verified），否则返回 400；可先调用 TestConnectivity 完成验证
parameters.name: target_id

parameters.help_en: The detection intensity. The backend derives the corresponding technique level based on this value. If this parameter is not specified, the system falls back to the scan task configuration saved for the target, and then to the system default value
parameters.help_zh: 检测强度，后端按此派生对应的手法等级；不传时依次回退到目标已保存的扫描任务配置与系统默认值
parameters.name: sample_level

parameters.help_en: The language filter for samples, in locale format (such as zh_CN or en_US, which is internally normalized to zh or en). If this parameter is not specified, samples are selected based on the default language policy combined with general-purpose samples
parameters.help_zh: 样本语言过滤，locale 格式（如 zh_CN、en_US，内部归一为 zh、en）；不传时结合通用样本按默认语言策略选样
parameters.name: lang

Data.description_en: The creation result, which contains the TaskId of the new scan task
Data.description_zh: 创建结果，返回新扫描任务的 TaskId

TaskId.description_en: The unique identifier of the scan task. The initial task status is PREPARING (asynchronous preparation in progress). You can call ListScanTasksByTarget to query the task status and progress
TaskId.description_zh: 扫描任务的唯一标识。任务初始状态为 PREPARING（异步准备中），可通过 ListScanTasksByTarget 查询任务状态与进度

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which is used for troubleshooting and log tracing
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于问题排查与日志追踪
